known_provisional_constraints.limitation: rough temporary generation envelope; not an official redline
rough key-area envelopes; not parcel, road, ownership, or approval boundaries

missing_constraint_register.needed: approved FAR, height, density, setback and building-control lines
missing_constraint_register.design_consequence: all proposed massing remains a low-confidence design model

missing_constraint_register.needed: cadastral parcels, ownership and existing land-use inventory
missing_constraint_register.design_consequence: no parcel-level retain/renovate/demolish or delivery claim is made

missing_constraint_register.needed: road redlines, intersections, parking/access and traffic survey
rail/heritage alignment, protection distances and station interfaces
missing_constraint_register.design_consequence: no protection, excavation or engineering feasibility conclusion is made

missing_constraint_register.needed: heritage protection scope and construction-control zone
missing_constraint_register.design_consequence: heritage references remain narrative/design intent only

missing_constraint_register.needed: surveyed water, blue line, flood risk, groundwater and drainage catchments
missing_constraint_register.design_consequence: green-space rain gardens are conceptual and no watercourse is fabricated

missing_constraint_register.needed: utilities, energy, fire access, emergency, geotechnical and environmental surveys
missing_constraint_register.design_consequence: implementation and phasing require professional recalibration

missing_constraint_register.needed: building age/condition/use/height and facility service data
missing_constraint_register.design_consequence: building footprints are concept massing, not surveyed existing buildings

data_gap.recalculation_trigger: Any official or rights-cleared constraint dataset must replace the corresponding gap; then rerun tools/rebuild_spatial_model.py and professional traffic, heritage, municipal, fire, accessibility, geotechnical and cost review before implementation use.
data_gap.note_zh: 空要素集是刻意的数据诚信选择：没有可引用的官方/已清权约束几何时，不以推定线替代法定控制线。
data_gap.note_en: The empty feature set is intentional: inferred lines are not substituted for unavailable official or cleared constraints.
